{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_crc32_d4 (
    input wire [3:0] data_in,
    input wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [3:0] data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    // Independent feedback bits for the four reflected CRC steps.
    wire [3:0] f;
    wire p01, p12, p23;
    assign f = data_in ^ state_in[3:0];
    assign data_out = f;
    assign p01 = f[0] ^ f[1];
    assign p12 = f[1] ^ f[2];
    assign p23 = f[2] ^ f[3];

    assign state_out[0]  = state_in[4];
    assign state_out[1]  = state_in[5];
    assign state_out[2]  = state_in[6] ^ f[0];
    assign state_out[3]  = state_in[7] ^ f[1];
    assign state_out[4]  = state_in[8] ^ f[2];
    assign state_out[5]  = state_in[9] ^ f[3];
    assign state_out[6]  = state_in[10] ^ p01;
    assign state_out[7]  = state_in[11] ^ p12;
    assign state_out[8]  = state_in[12] ^ p23;
    assign state_out[9]  = state_in[13] ^ f[3];
    assign state_out[10] = state_in[14];
    assign state_out[11] = state_in[15];
    assign state_out[12] = state_in[16] ^ f[0];
    assign state_out[13] = state_in[17] ^ f[1];
    assign state_out[14] = state_in[18] ^ f[2];
    assign state_out[15] = state_in[19] ^ f[3];
    assign state_out[16] = state_in[20] ^ f[0];
    assign state_out[17] = state_in[21] ^ p01;
    assign state_out[18] = (state_in[22] ^ f[2]) ^ p01;
    assign state_out[19] = (state_in[23] ^ f[1]) ^ p23;
    assign state_out[20] = (state_in[24] ^ f[0]) ^ p23;
    assign state_out[21] = (state_in[25] ^ f[3]) ^ p01;
    assign state_out[22] = state_in[26] ^ p12;
    assign state_out[23] = (state_in[27] ^ f[0]) ^ p23;
    assign state_out[24] = (state_in[28] ^ f[3]) ^ p01;
    assign state_out[25] = state_in[29] ^ p12;
    assign state_out[26] = (state_in[30] ^ f[0]) ^ p23;
    assign state_out[27] = (state_in[31] ^ f[3]) ^ p01;
    assign state_out[28] = p01 ^ f[2];
    assign state_out[29] = f[1] ^ p23;
    assign state_out[30] = p23;
    assign state_out[31] = f[3];
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The measured critical paths originate at state_in[2] and traverse input buffering and a multilevel mapped parity network. Independently reducing flattened state/data masks misses the explicit shared feedback structure and can increase parity depth and input loading.",
  "rewrite": "Factor the transform through f[i] = state_in[i] XOR data_in[i]. For reflected polynomial 0xEDB88320, its four low bits are zero, so these are exactly the four successive feedback bits and data_out equals f. Expand state_out = (state_in >> 4) XOR (f[0] ? 0x1DB71064 : 0) XOR (f[1] ? 0x3B6E20C8 : 0) XOR (f[2] ? 0x76DC4190 : 0) XOR (f[3] ? 0xEDB88320 : 0). Share two-feedback parities and balance three-feedback-plus-state expressions into parallel branches.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The RTL has at most three two-input XOR levels from any input to an output, before mapping and buffering. Explicit feedback factoring and balanced branches target a reduction from the measured 0.82 ns baseline. No numerical gain is claimed without running the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses 44 two-input XOR operations before synthesis sharing or restructuring, plus direct wires. Feedback terms and pair parities have multiple loads and may require buffering. Area is expected to remain below the 1318.514560 um2 cap, but mapped area and electrical compliance require evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Complete combinational implementation of the fixed, parameterless pw_crc32_d4 interface. Preserves unsigned port widths and both outputs for every binary data_in and arbitrary state_in. No initialization, final CRC inversion, state, latency, latches, helper modules, or external dependencies are introduced."
}
